name: Halcyon Quay
tagline: The command deck for every vessel, slip, and tide you answer to.
positioning: Halcyon Quay unifies berth planning, maintenance logs, and dockside billing into one serene, seaworthy platform for owners and independent harbor keepers.

hero.h1: Every mooring, mastered. Every tide, anticipated.
hero.sub: Halcyon Quay is the private harbor platform for people who take their waterfront seriously — one calm dashboard for slips, service, and season passes.

features.title: Living berth map
features.description: Drag vessels across a real-time slip plan that knows draft, beam, and shore-power draw — no more penciled dock diagrams that lie by noon.

features.title: Tide-aware scheduling
features.description: Haul-outs, fuel runs, and guest arrivals auto-align to the local tide table and marine forecast so you never book a launch against a falling tide.

features.title: Hull & engine ledger
features.description: Every anode swap, bottom paint, and oil change logged against the vessel — a maintenance record buyers actually trust at survey time.

features.title: Dockside billing
features.description: Seasonal contracts, transient nights, and metered power settle to one invoice, with card and ACH captured before the lines are cleated.

features.title: Storm playbook
features.description: When a system builds offshore, trigger your evacuation and haul sequence and notify every slip holder in a single confident broadcast.

features.title: Guest moorings
features.description: Publish available transient berths, take deposits, and hand visiting captains a gate code — your dock earns while you sleep.

testimonials.quote: I run forty slips and a fuel dock alone. Halcyon Quay replaced three whiteboards, a shoebox of receipts, and the dread of hurricane season. My berth map is finally honest.
testimonials.name: Delphine Marchetti

testimonials.quote: The maintenance ledger sold my trawler for eight thousand more. Every service since 2019 exported clean at the survey. Buyers stop haggling when the record is this immaculate.
testimonials.name: Rowan Ashford

testimonials.quote: Tide-aware scheduling is quietly genius. We stopped launching boats into a two-knot ebb and our lift crew reclaimed an hour every morning. It just feels inevitable now.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
